survey_records.wording: Should voters have to present official photo identification at the polls on Election Day?
survey_records.wording_note: Paraphrased question summary. Original question gives a driver’s license as an example. PDF page 47 (printed page 46), Q57, asked all respondents. Nationwide telephone survey of adults, including an oversample in competitive congressional districts; methodology on PDF page 15 and sample/date header on page 20.
survey_records.weight: Published national topline; no respondent-level recalculation or new weighting.
survey_records.denominator: All 2,006 adults in the survey, including don’t know/refused responses; not just registered voters. Published percentages retained without normalization.
survey_records.orientation: Support means favoring a photo-ID requirement.

response_distribution.label: Should not have to do this
